children: Catcher Predict reported a sharp move in the Polymarket submarket for the Seattle Mariners vs. Boston Red Sox event. According to ChainCatcher, the Boston Red Sox option in the first five innings -1.5 submarket rose from 34.5% one hour earlier to 50%, a 15.5 percentage point increase. The report said related breaking news may have affected the shift.

title: Polymarket Seattle Mariners-Boston Red Sox Submarket Sees Sharp Odds Swing
